token_basis.resident_bytes: name_bytes -- the tool NAMES, carried on every request for every mounted server. This is the cost the fleet actually pays per turn under a deferred-schema client, and the basis this table ranks by.
token_basis.contingent_bytes: schema_bytes -- the full tool schemas, paid only when a schema is materialised. Large but mostly unpaid here; ranking by it ranks by a cost the fleet does not incur. Kept visible so the choice of basis stays auditable.
token_basis.resident_share_pct_of_sampled: this row's share of the resident bytes of the SAMPLED servers only -- the ones with a stdio child to enumerate. It is NOT a share of the fleet: the unsampled rows contribute an unknown, non-zero amount to the true denominator, so the real fleet share of any row is strictly LOWER than this number. The scope is in the field name on purpose, because a bare percentage gets copied and its footnote does not.
token_basis.resident_bytes_over_dead_backends: the slice of resident cost buying tools whose BACKEND was measured non-functional. Attributed per tool via backend_map (exact, not pro-rated) and reconciled against the committed name_bytes by C3. Null where no tool->backend map exists -- null means NOT ATTRIBUTED, never zero.
token_basis.not_measured: a server with no sampled tool surface (HTTP transport, no stdio child to spawn). Excluded from the ranking and counted in the header. Not zero.

regime: deferred-schema client: tool NAMES are resident, schemas are pulled on selection. Under an eager client the contingent column becomes the resident one and this ranking inverts -- the basis is a property of the CLIENT, not of the servers, so it is stated rather than assumed.

sampled_aggregate.scope: SUMS OVER THE SAMPLED ROWS ONLY -- the 16 of 23 mounted servers with a stdio child to enumerate. These are NOT fleet totals: the 7 unsampled rows contribute an unknown, non-zero amount, so every figure here is a LOWER BOUND on the fleet. The scope is in the block name and in each value key on purpose -- a bare number gets copied into prose and its footnote does not.

headline: cloud-hub is 60.1% of the every-turn resident cost of the 16 SAMPLED servers -- NOT of the fleet: 7 of 23 rows have no stdio child to enumerate, so their names are unmeasured (never zero) and the true fleet share of this row is strictly lower. 5,125 B of the row (73.2%, ~1,281 tokens on EVERY request, rough) buys tools whose backend was measured non-functional

refuted.round_2_wording: cloud-hub is 60.1% of every-turn resident MCP cost -- and, at its widest in LANE-MCPRESEARCH-GROUNDING.md, 'of the FLEET's every-turn resident MCP cost'
refuted.why: the arithmetic was right and the SENTENCE was wider than it: the denominator is the sampled rows only. Kept here rather than deleted so the wording that shipped stays auditable
refuted.still_true: cloud-hub IS the largest resident row by a wide margin, and the dead-backend slice of it is unchanged. Only the scope of the percentage moved
refuted.round_3_wording: the aggregate block was named `fleet` and held `tools: 707`, `resident_bytes: 11645`, `contingent_bytes: 603233` -- all sums over the 16 sampled rows. Downstream prose then read '707 tools' as a fleet total in MCP-FLEET-AUDIT.md, MCP-CAPABILITY-AND-DISPOSITION.md (COVERAGE line, the TOTAL table row and the DoD ledger), and in LANE-MCPRESEARCH-BUILD-R3.md, which called it 'the fleet total' three sections after fixing the per-row share
refuted.round_3_why: the SAME defect as round 2's, one level up: round 3 fixed the share and left the aggregate that feeds it labelled fleet. Measured, not inferred: sum(row.tool_count) over the 16 ranked rows == 707 exactly, and 7 of the 23 mounted rows carry tool_count null. Kept here rather than deleted so the wording that shipped stays auditable

controls.C1_rank_movement: 12/16 rows change rank between the two bases -- the basis choice is load-bearing, not decorative
controls.C2_fail_closed: a run with zero measurable rows raises instead of publishing
controls.C3_reconciliation: per-tool attribution re-sums EXACTLY to the committed name_bytes for ['cloud-hub'] -- an estimate that cannot be checked is not an attribution
controls.C4_slice_bound: no adjusted slice may exceed its own row's resident bytes
controls.C5_denominator_declared: the headline names its denominator (16 of 23 rows sampled) or the run fails -- the round-2 overclaim was a share quoted without its scope
controls.C6_aggregate_scope_in_keys: the aggregate block is not named `fleet` and every summed value key ends in `_sampled` -- C5 protected the per-row share while the block one level up still published sampled sums under a fleet label, and five prose sites copied them as fleet totals
